neta-01-c2.text: L. Xu, S. Ha, I. Rhee, V. Goel, L. Eggert (2023). CUBIC for Fast and Long-Distance Networks (RFC 9438). IETF RFC Editor.
neta-01-c2.quote: For RTT-fairness, CUBIC is designed to achieve linear bandwidth sharing among flows with different RTTs.
neta-01-c2.claim: Growth depends on the time since the last loss, not on RTT, which makes CUBIC RTT-fair
